# How to make motion graphics with Claude Code (HyperFrames, Remotion)

**Turn text, a logo or numbers into kinetic type, titles, transitions, overlays, maps or shader stings, rendered locally for free.**

**Price:** free. Every step runs locally or only plans and writes; no API key.

<p><a href="../../kinetic-type-art/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_9f9aa09abad7.webp" alt="Kinetic type cuts on the beat: one word strobing through typefaces, big red and white word slams, then a word corridor rushing toward the camera." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`kinetic-type-art`](../../kinetic-type-art/README.md): 17 kinetic type templates: one word per beat, typeface strobe, word tunnel, wordmark glitch. The other 7 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill kinetic-type-art --skill title-design --skill transition-craft --skill social-overlays --skill paper-shaders --skill motion-formats --skill maps-and-data-motion --skill varg-video-edit-library
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Animate our logo ./logo.svg into a 4-second liquid-metal sting in our brand orange, transparent background."*

## FAQ

### Can Claude Code make motion graphics?

Yes. The agent writes the animation as HTML (HyperFrames) or React (Remotion) and renders frame-exact MP4, WebM or transparent MOV. These skills give it exact presets (frames per beat, letter-spacing, easing, safe areas) instead of guesses.

### Remotion or HyperFrames?

Both: every template lists how to build it, starting from named HyperFrames blocks or Remotion equivalents. Values are driven from timeline time, so any frame renders the same on a re-render.

### Can it animate my logo?

Yes: paper-shaders for liquid-metal, god-ray and grain logo stings, kinetic-type-art for wordmark reveals, motion-formats for a wave through the wordmark or a VHS bouncing-logo screensaver, title-design for a channel bumper.

### How do I make lower thirds and title cards?

title-design sets hold time from word count, safe areas for 16:9 and 9:16 from EBU rules, type scale by frame height and enter and exit easing.

### Does it cost credits?

No. These templates render locally for free and use only OFL or Apache fonts.
